title: RHONDOS completes acquisition of PowerConnect for SAP Solutions from SoftwareOne
date_note: The press release of 24 November says the closing happened that day; the deal was announced in January 2026.
geo_basis: dateline of the RHONDOS press release
summary: RHONDOS says in a press release that it has closed its acquisition of the PowerConnect for SAP Solutions business from SoftwareOne, completing the transaction announced in January 2026. Financial terms were not disclosed in the release. RHONDOS founder and CEO Brant Hubbard says the company is investing to make SAP data a trusted foundation for enterprise AI.
plain: RHONDOS has finished buying the PowerConnect for SAP business from SoftwareOne. The price was not disclosed.
exec: RHONDOS says it now owns PowerConnect for SAP Solutions, bought from SoftwareOne; financial terms were not disclosed.

validation.note: RHONDOS's own GlobeNewswire release read via finanznachrichten.de; recorder.ca carries the same release but did not load.
